quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Numbers to 3] Use the Make-a-Ten strategy to solve 8 + 6: move 2 from 6 to make 10 + ? = ?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Decompose 6 into 2 + 4. Combine 8 + 2 = 10, then add the remaining 4: 10 + 4 = 14.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Numbers to 3] Use addition to solve the unknown-addend subtraction: 13 - 8 = ? (Think: 8 + ? = 13)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Hop from 8 to 10 (+2) and from 10 to 13 (+3): 2 + 3 = 5, so 13 - 8 = 5.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Numbers to 3] Which equation is TRUE? (Remember: the equal sign means both sides have the same value!)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Left side: 7 + 5 = 12. Right side: 10 + 2 = 12. Since 12 = 12, the scale is balanced!

quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Daily calendar routines, seasonal counting sets, number puzzles & syllable-clap counting (MA.1-4)] The short hour hand is between 3 and 4, and the long minute hand points to 6. What time is it?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Skip-count by 5s to the 6 (30 minutes). The hour hand has passed 3, so it is 3:30.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Daily calendar routines, seasonal counting sets, number puzzles & syllable-clap counting (MA.1-4)] Soccer practice starts at 4:15 PM and lasts 45 minutes. When does it end?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Hop +45 minutes on the time number line from 4:15: 15 + 45 = 60 minutes (1 full hour), reaching 5:00 PM.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Daily calendar routines, seasonal counting sets, number puzzles & syllable-clap counting (MA.1-4)] How many minutes are in 1 whole hour?
sampleQuestions.explanation: There are 12 numbers on the clock face with 5 minutes between each: 12 × 5 = 60 minutes.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Flat shapes] Count the mixed coins: 2 quarters, 1 dime, and 3 pennies. What is the total?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Start with quarters: 25¢, 50¢. Add 1 dime: 60¢. Add 3 pennies: 61¢, 62¢, 63¢.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Flat shapes] Which coin shows Abraham Lincoln on the front (heads) and is worth 1¢?

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Addition up to 5] Use the Make-a-Ten strategy to solve 8 + 6: move 2 from 6 to make 10 + ? = ?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Decompose 6 into 2 + 4. Combine 8 + 2 = 10, then add the remaining 4: 10 + 4 = 14.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Addition up to 5] Use addition to solve the unknown-addend subtraction: 13 - 8 = ? (Think: 8 + ? = 13)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Hop from 8 to 10 (+2) and from 10 to 13 (+3): 2 + 3 = 5, so 13 - 8 = 5.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Addition up to 5] Which equation is TRUE? (Remember: the equal sign means both sides have the same value!)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Left side: 7 + 5 = 12. Right side: 10 + 2 = 12. Since 12 = 12, the scale is balanced!

quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Color and number words] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.
choices: The rain fell, so we played inside.
The rain fell we played inside.
The rain, fell so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: The rain fell, so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Use a comma followed by the coordinating conjunction so to show cause and effect between two complete thoughts.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Color and number words] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?
choices: To carry across from one place to another
To write a story about life
To look closely at small things
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To carry across from one place to another
sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Color and number words] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Numbers to 3
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Numbers to 3] Use the Make-a-Ten strategy to solve 8 + 6: move 2 from 6 to make 10 + ? = ?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Decompose 6 into 2 + 4. Combine 8 + 2 = 10, then add the remaining 4: 10 + 4 = 14.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Numbers to 3] Use addition to solve the unknown-addend subtraction: 13 - 8 = ? (Think: 8 + ? = 13)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Hop from 8 to 10 (+2) and from 10 to 13 (+3): 2 + 3 = 5, so 13 - 8 = 5.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Numbers to 3] Which equation is TRUE? (Remember: the equal sign means both sides have the same value!)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Left side: 7 + 5 = 12. Right side: 10 + 2 = 12. Since 12 = 12, the scale is balanced!

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Subtraction word problems up to 10] Use addition to solve the unknown-addend subtraction: 13 - 8 = ? (Think: 8 + ? = 13)

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Subtraction word problems up to 10] Which equation is TRUE? (Remember: the equal sign means both sides have the same value!)

choices: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Fractions of shapes
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Fractions of shapes] A rectangle is partitioned into 4 equal shares and 3 shares are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The denominator (4) tells total equal parts in the whole; the numerator (3) tells shaded parts: 3/4.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Fractions of shapes] Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2 on the number line?
sampleQuestions.explanation: 2/4 lands on the exact same midpoint between 0 and 1 as 1/2.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Fractions of shapes] Compare two fractions of the same whole: 2/6 ___ 2/3.
sampleQuestions.explanation: When numerators are the same (2 parts), sixths are smaller pieces than thirds because the whole is cut into more shares.

quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Identify shapes across orientations/sizes & model 2D/3D shapes from sticks, clay balls, and components (K.G.2, K.G.5)] A rectangular garden is 6 feet long and 4 feet wide. What is its area in square feet?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Tile 6 rows of 4 unit squares: Area = length × width = 6 × 4 = 24 square feet.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Identify shapes across orientations/sizes & model 2D/3D shapes from sticks, clay balls, and components (K.G.2, K.G.5)] Which attribute is a DEFINING attribute of every triangle?
choices: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners
sampleQuestions.explanation: Color, size, and orientation do not change a shape; 3 closed straight sides and 3 vertices define a triangle.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Identify shapes across orientations/sizes & model 2D/3D shapes from sticks, clay balls, and components (K.G.2, K.G.5)] A rectangle has a perimeter of 20 cm and a length of 7 cm. What is its unknown width?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Two lengths equal 7 + 7 = 14 cm. Subtract from 20 cm: 20 - 14 = 6 cm for the two widths, so each width is 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm.

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Color and number words
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Color and number words] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.
choices: The rain fell, so we played inside.
The rain fell we played inside.
The rain, fell so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: The rain fell, so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Use a comma followed by the coordinating conjunction so to show cause and effect between two complete thoughts.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Color and number words] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?
choices: To carry across from one place to another
To write a story about life
To look closely at small things
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To carry across from one place to another
sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Color and number words] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Shapes and colors
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shapes and colors] When liquid water is heated in a pot and turns into water vapor (gas), what phase change has occurred?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Adding thermal energy causes liquid water particles to speed up and escape as gas (evaporation).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shapes and colors] You bring the North pole of Magnet A close to the North pole of Magnet B. What happens?
choices: They repel (push away from) each other
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: They repel (push away from) each other

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Addition and subtraction: multiples of ten] Subtract across zeros: 400 - 167 = ?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Unbundle 4 hundreds into 3 hundreds, 9 tens, and 10 ones: (300-100) + (90-60) + (10-7) = 233.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Addition and subtraction: multiples of ten] What is 706 written in expanded form?
sampleQuestions.explanation: 706 has 7 hundreds (700), 0 tens (0), and 6 ones (6): 700 + 6.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Addition and subtraction: multiples of ten] Mentally find 100 more and 10 less than 582.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Adding 100 increases the hundreds digit (5 -> 6: 682); subtracting 10 decreases the tens digit (8 -> 7: 572).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Measurement] Count the mixed coins: 2 quarters, 1 dime, and 3 pennies. What is the total?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Start with quarters: 25¢, 50¢. Add 1 dime: 60¢. Add 3 pennies: 61¢, 62¢, 63¢.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Measurement] An apple costs 45¢. You pay with 2 quarters (50¢). How much change do you get?

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Nouns and adjectives] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.
choices: The rain fell, so we played inside.
The rain fell we played inside.
The rain, fell so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: The rain fell, so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Use a comma followed by the coordinating conjunction so to show cause and effect between two complete thoughts.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Nouns and adjectives] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?
choices: To carry across from one place to another
To write a story about life
To look closely at small things
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To carry across from one place to another
sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Nouns and adjectives] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Shapes and colors
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shapes and colors] When liquid water is heated in a pot and turns into water vapor (gas), what phase change has occurred?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Adding thermal energy causes liquid water particles to speed up and escape as gas (evaporation).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shapes and colors] You bring the North pole of Magnet A close to the North pole of Magnet B. What happens?
choices: They repel (push away from) each other
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: They repel (push away from) each other
sampleQuestions.explanation: Like magnetic poles (N-N or S-S) repel each other; opposite poles (N-S) attract.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Shapes and colors] In a forest food chain (Sunlight -> Oak Tree -> Squirrel -> Hawk), what role does the Oak Tree play?
choices: Producer (makes its own food using sunlight)
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Producer (makes its own food using sunlight)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Plants are producers because they use sunlight, water, and air to make food via photosynthesis.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Add up to four two-digit numbers using partial sums, expanded form, and empty number line strategies (2.NBT.6)] Which attribute is a DEFINING attribute of every triangle?
choices: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners
sampleQuestions.explanation: Color, size, and orientation do not change a shape; 3 closed straight sides and 3 vertices define a triangle.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Add up to four two-digit numbers using partial sums, expanded form, and empty number line strategies (2.NBT.6)] A rectangle has a perimeter of 20 cm and a length of 7 cm. What is its unknown width?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Two lengths equal 7 + 7 = 14 cm. Subtract from 20 cm: 20 - 14 = 6 cm for the two widths, so each width is 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Repeated addition] Use the Distributive Property to break apart 7 × 8: 7 × (5 + 3) = ?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Slice the 7×8 array into a 7×5 array (35) and a 7×3 array (21): 35 + 21 = 56.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Repeated addition] Find the unknown factor: 54 ÷ ? = 9 (Think: 9 × ? = 54)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Division is the inverse of multiplication: since 9 × 6 = 54, 54 ÷ 6 = 9.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Repeated addition] Why is the product of 4 × any whole number always an EVEN number?
choices: Because 4 = 2 + 2, so the product can always be split into two equal addends
Because odd numbers cannot be multiplied
Only when multiplied by an even number
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Because 4 = 2 + 2, so the product can always be split into two equal addends
sampleQuestions.explanation: 4 × n = (2 × n) + (2 × n), which pairs every object into groups of 2 with zero remainder.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Identify both sides (heads and tails) of US coins and bills & solve mixed currency word problems using $ and ¢ symbols (2.MD.8)] Count the mixed coins: 2 quarters, 1 dime, and 3 pennies. What is the total?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Start with quarters: 25¢, 50¢. Add 1 dime: 60¢. Add 3 pennies: 61¢, 62¢, 63¢.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Identify both sides (heads and tails) of US coins and bills & solve mixed currency word problems using $ and ¢ symbols (2.MD.8)] Which coin shows Abraham Lincoln on the front (heads) and is worth 1¢?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The copper penny features Abraham Lincoln and equals 1 cent (1¢).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Identify both sides (heads and tails) of US coins and bills & solve mixed currency word problems using $ and ¢ symbols (2.MD.8)] An apple costs 45¢. You pay with 2 quarters (50¢). How much change do you get?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Count up from 45¢ to 50¢: 45 + 5 = 50, so your change is 5¢.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Time] The short hour hand is between 3 and 4, and the long minute hand points to 6. What time is it?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Skip-count by 5s to the 6 (30 minutes). The hour hand has passed 3, so it is 3:30.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Time] Soccer practice starts at 4:15 PM and lasts 45 minutes. When does it end?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Hop +45 minutes on the time number line from 4:15: 15 + 45 = 60 minutes (1 full hour), reaching 5:00 PM.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Time] How many minutes are in 1 whole hour?
sampleQuestions.explanation: There are 12 numbers on the clock face with 5 minutes between each: 12 × 5 = 60 minutes.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Two-dimensional shapes] A rectangle is partitioned into 4 equal shares and 3 shares are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The denominator (4) tells total equal parts in the whole; the numerator (3) tells shaded parts: 3/4.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Two-dimensional shapes] Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2 on the number line?
sampleQuestions.explanation: 2/4 lands on the exact same midpoint between 0 and 1 as 1/2.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Two-dimensional shapes] Compare two fractions of the same whole: 2/6 ___ 2/3.
sampleQuestions.explanation: When numerators are the same (2 parts), sixths are smaller pieces than thirds because the whole is cut into more shares.

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Organizing writing
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Organizing writing] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.
choices: The rain fell, so we played inside.
The rain fell we played inside.
The rain, fell so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: The rain fell, so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Use a comma followed by the coordinating conjunction so to show cause and effect between two complete thoughts.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Organizing writing] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?
choices: To carry across from one place to another
To write a story about life
To look closely at small things
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To carry across from one place to another
sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Organizing writing] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Mixed operations: addition and subtraction] Use the Make-a-Ten strategy to solve 8 + 6: move 2 from 6 to make 10 + ? = ?

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Mixed operations: addition and subtraction] Use addition to solve the unknown-addend subtraction: 13 - 8 = ? (Think: 8 + ? = 13)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Hop from 8 to 10 (+2) and from 10 to 13 (+3): 2 + 3 = 5, so 13 - 8 = 5.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Mixed operations: addition and subtraction] Which equation is TRUE? (Remember: the equal sign means both sides have the same value!)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Left side: 7 + 5 = 12. Right side: 10 + 2 = 12. Since 12 = 12, the scale is balanced!

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Skip-counting
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Skip-counting] Use the Distributive Property to break apart 7 × 8: 7 × (5 + 3) = ?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Slice the 7×8 array into a 7×5 array (35) and a 7×3 array (21): 35 + 21 = 56.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Skip-counting] Find the unknown factor: 54 ÷ ? = 9 (Think: 9 × ? = 54)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Division is the inverse of multiplication: since 9 × 6 = 54, 54 ÷ 6 = 9.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Skip-counting] Why is the product of 4 × any whole number always an EVEN number?
choices: Because 4 = 2 + 2, so the product can always be split into two equal addends
Because odd numbers cannot be multiplied
Only when multiplied by an even number
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Because 4 = 2 + 2, so the product can always be split into two equal addends
sampleQuestions.explanation: 4 × n = (2 × n) + (2 × n), which pairs every object into groups of 2 with zero remainder.

Because odd numbers cannot be multiplied
Only when multiplied by an even number
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Because 4 = 2 + 2, so the product can always be split into two equal addends
sampleQuestions.explanation: 4 × n = (2 × n) + (2 × n), which pairs every object into groups of 2 with zero remainder.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Area] A rectangular garden is 6 feet long and 4 feet wide. What is its area in square feet?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Tile 6 rows of 4 unit squares: Area = length × width = 6 × 4 = 24 square feet.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Area] Which attribute is a DEFINING attribute of every triangle?
choices: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Closed shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Area] A rectangle has a perimeter of 20 cm and a length of 7 cm. What is its unknown width?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Two lengths equal 7 + 7 = 14 cm. Subtract from 20 cm: 20 - 14 = 6 cm for the two widths, so each width is 6 ÷ 2 = 3 cm.

sampleQuestions.explanation: When numerators are the same (2 parts), sixths are smaller pieces than thirds because the whole is cut into more shares.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Main idea] Read: Leo zipped up his heavy coat, pulled on wool mittens, and watched his breath turn into white puffs. What can you INFER about the setting?
choices: It is a freezing winter day outside.
Leo is going swimming at the beach.
It is a hot summer afternoon.
Leo is inside a warm kitchen.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: It is a freezing winter day outside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Clues: heavy coat + wool mittens + breath turning into white puffs = freezing cold weather.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Main idea] Which text structure does an article use when it explains why soil erodes and then describes three ways farmers stop erosion?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The passage introduces an environmental problem (soil erosion) followed by actionable solutions.

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Organizing writing
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Organizing writing] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.
choices: The rain fell, so we played inside.
The rain fell we played inside.
The rain, fell so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: The rain fell, so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Use a comma followed by the coordinating conjunction so to show cause and effect between two complete thoughts.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Organizing writing] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?
choices: To carry across from one place to another
To write a story about life
To look closely at small things
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To carry across from one place to another
sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Organizing writing] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Sentences, fragments, and run-ons
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Sentences, fragments, and run-ons] Combine the two simple sentences into a compound sentence: The rain fell. + We played inside.
choices: The rain fell, so we played inside.
The rain fell we played inside.
The rain, fell so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: The rain fell, so we played inside.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Use a comma followed by the coordinating conjunction so to show cause and effect between two complete thoughts.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Sentences, fragments, and run-ons] The Latin root PORT means to carry and the prefix TRANS- means across. What does TRANSPORT mean?
choices: To carry across from one place to another
To write a story about life
To look closely at small things
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: To carry across from one place to another
sampleQuestions.explanation: Trans- (across) + port (carry) = to carry goods or people across distances.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Sentences, fragments, and run-ons] Choose the correct homophone: The dogs wagged _____ tails when _____ owner arrived.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Their is a possessive pronoun showing ownership (their tails, their owner).

quizzes.title: Topic Check Quiz: Materials
quizzes.smartDistractorStrategy: Generates 3 misconception-targeted distractors per item based on common developmental errors.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Materials] When liquid water is heated in a pot and turns into water vapor (gas), what phase change has occurred?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Adding thermal energy causes liquid water particles to speed up and escape as gas (evaporation).

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Materials] You bring the North pole of Magnet A close to the North pole of Magnet B. What happens?
choices: They repel (push away from) each other
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: They repel (push away from) each other
sampleQuestions.explanation: Like magnetic poles (N-N or S-S) repel each other; opposite poles (N-S) attract.

sampleQuestions.prompt: [Materials] In a forest food chain (Sunlight -> Oak Tree -> Squirrel -> Hawk), what role does the Oak Tree play?
choices: Producer (makes its own food using sunlight)
sampleQuestions.correctAnswer: Producer (makes its own food using sunlight)
sampleQuestions.explanation: Plants are producers because they use sunlight, water, and air to make food via photosynthesis.

sampleQuestions.explanation: When quantity demanded is greater than quantity supplied, there is a shortage.
